findings.statement: A California registration for 'Albertacos Administration INC.' could not be confirmed or refuted: the California Secretary of State bizfile JSON API returned a security-service block (errorCode 15) and the search UI is JavaScript-only, so no registry result was obtained. Web search surfaced no 'Albertacos Administration' entity but did show a separate ALBERTACO'S MEXICAN FOOD, INC. in Vista CA, which is a different city and not this merchant. The San Bernardino County food-facility inspection portal (ehsportal.sbcounty.gov) did not respond (connection timeout) and ehs.sbcounty.gov returned 404, so the county health permit could not be checked either. Both registers blocked or failed automation; this is an untested dimension, not a negative finding.
findings.establishes: Neither the CA Secretary of State register nor the San Bernardino County health-permit register was reachable; corporate status and food-facility permit remain unchecked rather than absent.

findings.statement: An independent business listing places Albertacos Mexican Food at 3245 Little League Dr, San Bernardino, CA 92407, in San Bernardino County, with a Yelp-sourced rating from 168 reviews, a menu, photographs of food, a drive-thru, delivery and takeout, and listed opening hours. This matches the declared city and state and confirms a physical restaurant footprint.
findings.establishes: A real Albertacos Mexican fast-food restaurant physically operates in San Bernardino, CA at a specific street address, consistent with the merchant profile.

findings.statement: The representative could not be matched to any role on a public source tied to this business: no CA Secretary of State filing was retrievable because the registry blocked automation, no county health-permit holder record was reachable, and targeted searches for the representative together with the trade name and San Bernardino returned only unrelated people and institutional pages. Nothing contradicts the representative: no conflicting owner name, no other business in another city and no complaint or fraud report was found. Identity documents and bank ownership are verified only by Stripe (status: verified).
findings.establishes: No public source links or contradicts the representative's connection to this merchant; no adverse signal found.

findings.statement: No website was declared on the account. The email handle sb.albertacos3245@gmail.com coheres strongly with the business: 'sb' matches San Bernardino, 'albertacos' matches the trade name, and '3245' matches the street number 3245 Little League Dr shown on the independent listing. The statement descriptor 'ALBERTACOS ADMINISTRAT' is a plain 22-character truncation of the declared legal name 'Albertacos Administration INC.', not a random string. The listing does show a third-party ordering page under an s4shops.com subdomain, but fetching it was blocked by the research tool's provenance restriction, so it was not inspected and is not relied on.
findings.establishes: Email handle and statement descriptor both cohere with the merchant's name and physical location; no declared website to assess.

findings.statement: MCC 5812 (eating places / restaurants) is coherent with the observed business: the listing describes a Mexican restaurant serving tacos, burritos, carne asada plates, fries and churros, with breakfast, lunch and dinner service, a drive-thru, takeout and delivery, matching the declared product description of a fast food Mexican restaurant.
findings.establishes: The merchant's MCC, descriptor and product description match an observably operating Mexican fast-food restaurant.

findings.statement: Independent presence well over one year: the listing aggregates 168 Yelp reviews with dated entries ranging from four weeks to six months old, and includes a customer menu photograph captioned as of April 2023, giving a documented trading record of at least three years at this address. No scam, fraud or chargeback complaints about the business or its owner were found.
findings.establishes: The restaurant has a continuous, dated public trading history of three or more years with no fraud or scam reports.

evidenceNeeded: Manual check of California Secretary of State bizfile (bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov/search/business) for 'Albertacos Administration INC' to confirm active status, entity number, registered address and the officer or agent for service of process - the API and UI blocked automation.

Manual check of the San Bernardino County Environmental Health food-facility inspection record for 3245 Little League Dr, San Bernardino CA 92407, to confirm an active health permit and the permit holder - the county portal did not respond.
Confirm the account representative appears as officer, agent or health-permit holder on one of the above records.

Confirm whether the third-party ordering page linked from the listing (an s4shops.com subdomain for Albertacos Mexican Food) is operated by this merchant, since no website was declared; the page could not be fetched.

Check the single consumer food-illness post about this address on iwaspoisoned.com, described in search results as roughly seven years old; it was not loaded and is a food-quality rather than payment-fraud allegation, so it was not scored.
Confirm the settlement bank account is held in the name of Albertacos Administration INC. rather than an individual.
summary: A real Albertacos Mexican fast-food restaurant is confirmed operating at 3245 Little League Dr, San Bernardino, CA 92407, with 168 dated Yelp reviews and a public trading history going back to at least April 2023, so the business is not fabricated and MCC 5812 fits what it observably does. The email handle encodes the city, trade name and street number, and the descriptor is a straightforward truncation of the declared legal name, giving good coherence across declared data and observed footprint. The remaining gap is documentary rather than behavioural: both the California Secretary of State register and the San Bernardino County health-permit portal blocked or failed to respond to automation, so neither the corporate registration for 'Albertacos Administration INC.' nor the food-facility permit could be checked, and the representative could not be tied to the business through any public source. Total risk 0 with no contradictions found; recommend a manual registry and permit check to close the legal and identity evidence, noting Stripe already reports the entity verified with payouts enabled.
